changes.evidence: His U.S. Army special-ops service (34th Infantry Division, the Damascus mission) ended before Jessica Jones S1: he left the program and joined the NYPD before the show starts. In S1 he is an NYPD officer, rejoins IGH in episode 9 and quits it in episode 11.

Jessica Jones S2 flashbacks (episodes 8 and 11): Malus tells Alisa he is closing the IGH clinic, shuts IGH down, and the two move into a house together, where he keeps treating her outside IGH. IGH no longer exists in the present-day S2 story.

Jessica Jones S2 (episodes 8, 10 and 11 flashbacks): Malus shuts down IGH because he no longer trusts Kozlov and Hansen, and he goes on experimenting privately with Alisa. The wiki lists IGH as a former affiliation.

Jessica Jones S2 episode 9: she quits Trish Talk on air and Ronald Garcia hires her at ZCN as a reporter (episode 10: 'the new job' at ZCN). Jessica Jones S3 episode 1: she is given a show on ARN TV, which covers for her vigilante work. The wiki lists ZCN and ARN as former affiliations.

His K'un-Lun training ended centuries before Iron Fist S1, when he was banished and co-founded the Hand. He is in the Hand throughout Iron Fist S1 and The Defenders, and K'un-Lun is never a membership he holds on screen.
She was banished from K'un-Lun centuries ago and co-founded the Hand, which is backstory told in The Defenders episodes 4-5. She leads the Hand throughout The Defenders until Elektra kills her.
He was banished from K'un-Lun centuries ago with the other Fingers and co-founded the Hand, which is backstory told in The Defenders episode 4. He is in the Hand throughout The Defenders.
He was banished from K'un-Lun centuries ago and co-founded the Hand, which is backstory told in The Defenders episodes 4 and 8. He is in the Hand throughout The Defenders until Stick kills him.

Iron Fist S2 episode 7: after taking the Iron Fist, Davos recruits Ryhno's Gang, brings them to Eden Towers and trains them as his warriors. He leads them until the Battle at Eden Towers. The wiki lists Ryhno's Gang as a former affiliation.

Her U.S. Army service (Czech Republic, Sokovian captivity) ended with a medical discharge before Iron Fist S2. In S2 she works alone as a hired operative for Joy Meachum. With the Army stage removed, no group remains, which matches the existing 'left' entry.

The Punisher S1 episode 12: Russo kills the Homeland Security agents in Anvil HQ and blows up the building, destroying 'the company he had built from the ground up', and goes on the run. In S2 he builds Jigsaw's Crew from nothing ('built himself up from nothing twice').

The Punisher S1 episode 11 (wiki section 'Fired from the CIA'): Marion James tells Rawlins he has no place in the CIA, and that he must retire or she will burn him. He dies in episode 12 working outside the agency.

His U.S. Army service (1st Infantry Division, Iraq) ended with his discharge before The Punisher S1. In S1 he attends Curtis Hoyle's veterans support group, then stops going (Curtis says they miss him at sessions), is rejected by Anvil, and acts alone as a bomber.
